description: Stub schema for per-channel feature toggles in NullFeed. This is a planning artifact, not active config.
notes: Real implementation will store channel state in a registry (on-chain or committed off-chain).
Passwords will never be stored here in plaintext; this stub only models the presence of a password gate.
Feature flags will eventually be enforced by NullFeed gateways and/or clients.
This file is a stub to keep the design future-proof without blocking mainnet.
